findings.finding: Auditability of failed candidates: RunTriage persists the parsed or fail-open TriagePayload into Candidate.Output before running invariant checks. When invariant checks fail (e.g. residual conflict markers or out-of-scope edits), failCandidate marks the candidate status failed while retaining the output payload for post-mortem analysis.

Hunk spacing isolation in fixture generator: The 3-hunk fixture generates 25 padding comment lines between hunks in toy.go, safely exceeding overlap.DefaultThresholds().NearbyHunkLines (10 lines). This guarantees merge-tree classifies the 3 hunks independently rather than coalescing them.

Open questions remain properly uncommitted: Neither the exact non-decreasing numeric risk formula nor the production triage executor/model selection were hardcoded in the codebase; the production invoker remains stubbed/injected via TriageInvoker and risk bands are limited to low/medium/high constants.
